shortDescription: NetApp E-Series update the role of a storage array within an Asynchronous Mirror Group (AMG).

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity WebServices Proxy or embedded REST API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity WebServices Proxy or embedded REST API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity WebServices Proxy or embedded REST API.

options.name: force
options.description: Whether to force the role reversal regardless of the online-state of the primary

options.name: noSync
options.description: Whether to avoid synchronization prior to role reversal

options.name: role
options.description: Whether the array should be the primary or secondary array for the AMG

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the primary storage array for the async mirror action
